unit.meaning: Hourly forecast value; averaging semantics undocumented

selection.text: For each hourly forecast period, only WINDFOR records with publishTime at or before the decision time are eligible; the one with the greatest publishTime is used.

mapping.text: Each hourly forecast applies to both half-hour settlement periods of its hour.

duplicates.text: Records sharing the deciding timestamp collapse if their values are equal and are excluded if they differ. Older vintages are never used as a fallback.

percentiles.text: The p-th percentile is the value at rank ceil(p·n) of the ascending sorted values.

metricDefinitions.description: Average size of the error, ignoring direction.
Like MAE but gives large misses more weight.
Average signed error. Positive means over-forecasting. Opposite errors cancel, so read it alongside MAE.
